name: linear Gamma vertical coefficient before parent lock
formula_or_bound: C_DvGamma_total := |P_obs nabla(L_cg^-2 F_m D_v m - 2 Gamma_eff D_v ln L_cg)|/a_ref
interpretation: 4299 first coefficient remains live if no zero route is signed.

name: second-order Gamma residual after double-zero lock
formula_or_bound: If m=m_*+delta_m and F=1/2 F_2 delta_m^2+O(delta_m^3), then D_v Gamma_eff=L_cg^-2 F_2 delta_m D_v delta_m - L_cg^-2 F_2 delta_m^2 D_v ln L_cg + O(delta_m^2D_vdelta_m,delta_m^3D_vlnL).
interpretation: The first Gamma source row is demoted from linear to quadratic only after parent lock is signed.

name: quadratic fallback bound
formula_or_bound: C_DvGamma_quad <= ||P_obs nabla[L_cg^-2 F_2 delta_m D_v delta_m - L_cg^-2 F_2 delta_m^2 D_v ln L_cg]||/a_ref
interpretation: Next empirical fallback needs delta_m, D_v delta_m, D_v ln L_cg, F_2, L_cg, P_obs and a_ref.

name: no cancellation between m and Lcg legs
formula_or_bound: Use absolute/component bounds unless parent identity forces cancellation.
interpretation: Prevents fitting the two legs against each other to dodge WEP.
